Data:Craft.hill.hollow sign.salt moon.js.Label: Craft: Salt-Sign
Data:Craft.hill.hollow sign.salt moon.js.StartDescription:
Use mud to trace a sigil of the silvered night. 

[Hill & Hollow with Prentice-level <sprite name=moon> creates Salt-Sign. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I trace the sign on an Egg, I can hatch something eyeless, but pulsing with potential.]

Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary forge.Label: Craft: Orpiment Exultant
Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary forge.StartDescription: Transform the essence into the encaustum terminale Orpiment Exultant. [Anbary & Lapidary with Keeper-level , plus Iotic Essence, creates Orpiment Exultant.]
Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary forge.Desc: [This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.].

Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary lanter.Label: Craft: Uzult
Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary lanter.StartDescription:
Purify this into a golden essence of Lantern-power.

[Anbary & Lapidary with Keeper-level <sprite name=lantern>, plus Xanthotic Essence, creates Uzult.]

Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary sky ic.Label: Craft: Ashartine
Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary sky ic.StartDescription:
Brew the bright ink ashartine from the ichor.

[Anbary & Lapidary with Keeper-level <sprite name=sky>, plus Ichor Vitreous, creates Ashartine.]
Data:Craft.keeper.anbary.lapidary sky ic.Desc: While the vapours of ashartine's making hang in the air, it is very difficult to speak a lie aloud….

Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies g.Label: Craft: Sacrament Calicite
Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies g.StartDescription:
Use this liquor as a base for a Grail-sacrament.

[Applebright Euphonies with Keeper-level <sprite name=grail>, plus Rubywise Ruin, creates Sacrament Calicite.]
Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies g.Desc: In the name of the Hour that gives life; of the Hour that takes life; of the Hour that is not sated….

Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies s.Label: Craft: Didumos
Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies s.StartDescription:
Evoke a chilly Sky-influence.

[Applebright Euphonies with Keeper-level <sprite name=sky>, plus Ascendant Harmony, creates Didumos.]
Data:Craft.keeper.applebrighteuphonies s.Desc: The dream of a star is not apparent to the human eye; but its presence, once felt, could not be mistaken for anything else.
